name: comp-251
title: Dual Range With Output
description: A dual-handle range slider. A label sits on the left and a live pair of values on the right, with the selected span drawn as a bright band between the two knobs.
use: A filter or setting needs a lower and an upper bound, and the numbers should stay visible.
avoid: Typing an exact figure matters: there are no number inputs here, only drag handles.
a11y: The slider has an aria-label, but the numeric output is separate text and is not announced when the handles move. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bold label on the left and a pair of numbers on the right, both on one line. Below runs a thin grey track with two round white knobs and a solid white bar filling the space between them.
behaves: Dragging either knob shifts that end of the range and repaints the filled band, and the two numbers beside the label change as the knobs move. The active knob picks up a soft halo while held.
customise: The label text and the starting pair of numbers are written in the source. The output format and the drag behaviour need a code edit to change.
weight: light: Two handles, one track and a text readout; no animation runs until it is dragged.
